newsitem.title: CANADA: Foreigners buy Canada securities in April.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners buy Canada securities in April.

text.p: Foreign investors bought a net C$4.18 billion in Canadian securities in April, after selling a net C$2.28 billion in March (revised from C$2.14 billion), Statistics Canada said on Monday.
Canadian residents bought a net C$291 million of foreign securities after buying C$1.76 billion in March (revised from C$2.11 billion).

Canadian investment in foreign securities (blns of dollars):
(A minus sign indicates more purchases from than sales of securities to non-residents, i.e. an outflow of money from Canada, Statistics Canada said.)
The federal agency said foreigners in April made their largest investment in Canadian bonds since July 1994, when they spent C$6.9 billion.

But Canadians purchased their smallest amount of foreign securities in 10 months and bought well below the monthly average of nearly C$2.0 billion invested in foreign securities over the previous nine months, StatsCan said.
